name: Chunk Mesh Preparation
aliases: Greedy Meshed Geometry Generation for Chunk Faces
definition: The process of generating greedy meshed geometry for all 6 faces of a voxel chunk, handling visibility culling against neighbors.
summary: Chunk Mesh Preparation constructs a padded volume from neighboring chunks to enable greedy meshing that merges coplanar faces across boundaries, reducing triangle counts while avoiding artifacts.
